correctness.rationale: Let m=k−1, t=n+m, q=n+2m. The integer Laplacian blocks tI and −J−mI lead, under the unimodular coordinates u=b_n, z=a_n−b_n, d_i=a_i−a_n, e_i=b_i−b_n, to one free u, r=n−1 copies of t d_i−m e_i and t e_i−m d_i, with global relations t z−Σ e_i=0 and −t z−Σd_i=0. Replace first d/e coordinates by their sums via a simultaneous integral determinant-one transformation, eliminate them via the global relations, giving a single cyclic Z_{tq} and n−2 blocks [[t,−m],[−m,t]]. Each block has Smith invariant gcd(t,m)=g and determinant t²−m²=nq, hence g,nq/g. Spectral eigenvalues 0,2t,n^(n−1 times),q^(n−1 times) give matrix-tree product. Independent full weighted Laplacian reduced Smith forms and exact determinant computations matched (n,k)=(3,0),(4,3),(6,3),(8,1), including two even noncoprime examples. The proof does not divide by nonunits and addresses k=0 and connectedness n≥3.

final_claim: For n≥3,k≥0 multicrowns with k matching-parallel edges and one edge at every unmatched pair, g=gcd(n,k−1), q=n−2+2k, t=n−1+k, the critical group is (Z_g)^{n−2} ⊕ (Z_{nq/g})^{n−2} ⊕ Z_{tq}, and the tree count n^{n−2}q^{n−1}t; in particular the even noncoprime cases are covered.
